fields.name: Refrigerant Leak & Standing Pressure Verification (Rec #1)
fields.description: Electronic halide sniffer scan across all flange joints, Schrader valves, and mechanical seals.
fields.remark: Zero leak detected, holding 120 PSI standing pressure.
fields.suggestion: Proceed with full operational load test.

fields.name: Lubrication Oil Level & Differential Pressure Check (Rec #1)
fields.description: Inspect sight glass oil level and verify oil pump differential pressure reaches 25-30 PSI above suction.
fields.remark: Oil clean, differential holding at 28.5 PSI.
fields.suggestion: Scheduled next oil lab analysis for Q1 2027.

fields.name: Electrical Terminal Torque & Thermal Scan (Rec #1)
fields.description: Torque all 480V lug connections to manufacturer spec (45 ft-lbs) and inspect with FLIR thermal camera.
fields.remark: All phases balanced within 2°C.
fields.suggestion: No loose connections identified.

fields.name: Safety Interlock & Emergency Cutout Trip Test (Rec #1)
fields.description: Simulate high discharge pressure and low oil differential cutouts to verify instantaneous controller trip.
fields.remark: All safety trips operational within 0.8 seconds.
fields.suggestion: Pass safety certification standard.
